caption:
Pay now vs pay later. 💳
A $500 balance at 22% APR costs roughly $9 a month in interest if you carry it.
Pay it in full each month and that interest is $0.
This is general math, check your own card terms.
first_comment: Do you pay in full or carry a balance? 👇
